tool_input.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import AppHeader from '../../components/AppHeader.vue'
import BottomNav from '../../components/BottomNav.vue'
import { useStatusBar } from '../../composables/useStatusBar'
import { useMainNav } from '../../composables/useMainNav'

type Category = '项目检查' | '防台防汛'
type Target = 'pre' | 'mid' | 'post' | 'history'
interface AppEntry { title: string; icon: string; tone: string; target?: Target; checkType?: string }

const categories: Record<Category, AppEntry[]> = {
  项目检查: [
    { title: '物业自查', icon: '/static/assets/ref-ziCha.svg', tone: 'tone-2', checkType: '1' },
    { title: '街镇检查', icon: '/static/assets/ref-jieZhen.svg', tone: '', checkType: '2' },
    { title: '区县检查', icon: '/static/assets/ref-quXian.svg', tone: 'tone-1', checkType: '3' },
    { title: '市级检查', icon: '/static/assets/ref-shiJi.svg', tone: 'tone-3', checkType: '4' },
  ],
  防台防汛: [
    { title: '汛前检查', icon: '/static/assets/ref-xunQian.svg', tone: 'tone-3', target: 'pre' },
    { title: '汛中巡检', icon: '/static/assets/ref-xunZhong.svg', tone: '', target: 'mid' },
    { title: '汛后检查', icon: '/static/assets/ref-xunHou.svg', tone: 'tone-1', target: 'post' },
    { title: '历史记录', icon: '/static/assets/ref-liShi.svg', tone: 'tone-2', target: 'history' },
  ],
}
const sideIcons: Record<Category, string> = {
  项目检查: '/static/assets/23266.svg',
  防台防汛: '/static/assets/a4237.svg',
}
const category = ref<Category>('项目检查')
const list = () => categories[category.value]
const { statusBarStyle } = useStatusBar()
const { go } = useMainNav()
function open(app: AppEntry) {
  if (app.checkType) {
    uni.navigateTo({ url: `/pages/project-check/records/index?checkType=${app.checkType}` })
    return
  }
  if (!app.target) {
    uni.showToast({ title: '该服务暂未开放', icon: 'none' })
    return
  }
  uni.navigateTo({ url: app.target === 'history' ? '/pages/history/index' : `/pages/inspection/index?kind=${app.target}` })
}
function selectNav(key: string) {
  if (key === 'workbench') return
  go(key)
}
</script>

<template>
  <view class="screen" :style="statusBarStyle">
    <AppHeader title="工作台" />
    <view class="workspace">
      <view class="workspace-aside">
        <view v-for="name in (Object.keys(categories) as Category[])" :key="name" class="side-tab" :class="{ active: category === name }" role="button" @click="category = name">
          <image class="side-tab-image" :src="sideIcons[name]" />
          <text class="side-tab-text">{{ name }}</text>
        </view>
      </view>
      <view class="apps">
        <view class="section-title">
          <text class="section-title-text">{{ category }}</text>
        </view>
        <view class="app-grid">
          <view v-for="app in list()" :key="app.title" class="app-card" role="button" @click="open(app)">
            <view class="icon-well" :class="app.tone"><image class="icon-well-image" :src="app.icon" /></view>
            <text class="app-card-title">{{ app.title }}</text>
          </view>
        </view>
      </view>
    </view>
    <BottomNav active="workbench" @select="selectNav" />
  </view>
</template>
